figurative_meaning_en: Blind or sightless, a rural insult specifically for women
example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামের সেই চোখখাকি মেয়েটি কোনো কাজেই মন দিতে পারে না।
ওকে চোখখাকি বলে ডাকলে খুব রাগ করে।
example_sentences_in_english: That blind village girl can't focus on any work.
She gets very angry if called a sightless one.
note: This idiom is a colloquial insult rooted in rural Bengali speech, often used to mock women perceived as blind or oblivious.
